summary: Frontend-only test of VisaExplainer audio/subtitle/scene synchronization after ElevenLabs regeneration (İlknur Önal, speed=1.0) and audioMs-driven scene duration. All 8 requested scenarios PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: VisaExplainer.jsx line 145: sceneMs falls back to scene.voiceMs before audioMs loads; brief mismatch on very first frame before onLoadedMetadata fires — imperceptible in practice.

onEnded increments index but the scene-driven useEffect for silent mode is fine since soundOn is true; consider guarding against double-advance if audio 'ended' fires while user just toggled sound off (edge case).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Explainer audio sync verified end-to-end on preview URL. Audio durations match spec. Subtitle word-highlight tracks audio.currentTime/duration proportionally. One-shot playback confirmed (no loop). CTA nav OK.
